title: Red Bead Experiment with Dr. W. Edwards Deming
summary: Excerpts from W. Edwards Deming's Red Bead Experiment, where workers draw beads from a bowl and are judged on red ones that are largely down to chance. It shows how system variation, not individual effort, drives results.
why: HN cites it as a classic illustration of dysfunctional management, gamed targets, and blaming workers for systemic outcomes.

quote.text: It is a fascinating insight into how dysfunctional management systems operate and perpetuate.
